note: Generated by build.mjs from src/skins/quiet-cartographer.spec.mjs (the source). Values are the NIGHT ground; `day` lists the overrides of the day ground; `variants` the colour-blind-safe and high-contrast sets of each ground. Lengths are CSS px, colours #rrggbb, alphas 0..1. Live: ?skinset={"*":{"pip.size":12}} or __skinKit.setToken(id, name, value).

tokens.name: color.union
tokens.doc: Union: the pip, the staff and the carried-forward ring.  Azure, light enough to hold 4.5:1 on a dark aerial

tokens.name: color.confederate
tokens.doc: Confederate: vermilion, light enough to hold 4.5:1 on a dark aerial.  Blue against vermilion is the colour-blind-safe pair of Okabe and Ito in spirit (not their exact values)

tokens.name: color.unknown
tokens.doc: Side UNKNOWN (10 ids whose id prefix and state code disagree, Contested): the ink colour of the ground, hatched, never a side colour.  Neutral on purpose: it stays apart from both sides under every colour-vision type

tokens.name: color.unionFlag
tokens.doc: Union pennant cloth and the count inside it: a deeper azure than the pip, so the white numeral holds 4.5:1

tokens.name: color.confederateFlag
tokens.doc: Confederate pennant cloth: a deeper vermilion than the pip, white numeral at 5.1:1

tokens.name: color.glass
tokens.doc: The glass inside a carried-forward (hollow) pip or pennant: dark on the night ground, paper on the day ground

tokens.name: color.ink
tokens.doc: Lettering of unit codes and numerals

tokens.name: color.tintUnion
tokens.doc: Lettering of a Union formation or crowd (bold, tinted with its side)

tokens.name: color.tintConfederate
tokens.doc: Lettering of a Confederate formation or crowd

tokens.name: color.tintUnknown
tokens.doc: Lettering of a formation of unknown side

tokens.name: color.tintMixed
tokens.doc: Lettering of a crowd of both sides

tokens.name: color.halo
tokens.doc: The dark halo behind every letter and the dark glass of a carried-forward mark (on the DAY ground this is paper white)

tokens.name: color.ring
tokens.doc: The light ring of a fresh pip and the edge of a pennant (on the DAY ground this is dark ink: the ring is the outermost ink of a mark, so it is the colour that stands off the ground)

tokens.name: color.select
tokens.doc: The selection ring of a mark of unknown side (a Union or Confederate mark is ringed in its own colour)

tokens.name: color.numeral
tokens.doc: The count inside a pennant: always light, with its own dark halo, on both grounds (the cloth is mid-tone, so the halo carries the contrast)

tokens.name: color.numeralHalo
tokens.doc: The dark halo of that count

tokens.name: halo.width
tokens.doc: Width of the halo stroke behind lettering

tokens.name: halo.alpha
tokens.doc: Opacity of the halo stroke

tokens.name: halo.soft
tokens.doc: Opacity of the second, wider halo that softens the first

tokens.name: text.dimAlpha
tokens.doc: Opacity of lettering when the mark is carried forward (a fix a battle day old or more).  1: the lettering of a stale mark stays at full strength and keeps its 4.5:1; the hollow ring and pennant carry the age

tokens.name: pip.size
tokens.doc: Width of the pip, ring included.  Infantry is a disc, cavalry a diamond, artillery a triangle

tokens.name: pip.gap
tokens.doc: Space between the pip and its lettering: wide enough that the selection ring (which stands 2.2 px off the pip) never touches the first letter

tokens.name: pip.ring
tokens.doc: Width of the ring round a fresh pip: it is the outermost ink of the mark (ink on the day ground, light on the night ground), and becomes the side colour when the mark is carried forward

tokens.name: pip.ringHollow
tokens.doc: Width of the side-coloured ring of a carried-forward pip: thick enough to hold 3:1 against the ground at the opening zoom

tokens.name: unit.h
tokens.doc: Height of the body of a unit mark (the footprint adds the selection margin on each side)

tokens.name: name.alpha
tokens.doc: Opacity of the grown-in full name (the same semibold cut as the code, at full ink)

tokens.name: code.baseline
tokens.doc: Distance of the lettering baseline below the middle of a mark (the digits sit centred on the pip)

tokens.name: foot.size
tokens.doc: Width of the pip a pennant stands on (a division stands on a slightly larger one, a corps on the largest)

tokens.name: flag.w
tokens.doc: Length of a brigade pennant, swallow-tail or point included (a division flies 22 % larger, a corps 45 %)

tokens.name: flag.h
tokens.doc: Height of a brigade pennant

tokens.name: flag.notch
tokens.doc: Depth of the swallow-tail of a Union pennant and of the point of a Confederate one: the largest device of the mark that is neither colour nor text, so the armies read apart at a glance and in greyscale

tokens.name: flag.staff
tokens.doc: Length of the staff between the pip and the pennant

tokens.name: staff.width
tokens.doc: Width of the staff the pennant flies from; it stands on the pip, which is the place of the unit

tokens.name: flag.gap
tokens.doc: Space between a pennant and its lettering

tokens.name: flag.padX
tokens.doc: Space round the count inside a pennant that has to widen for two digits

tokens.name: flag.edge
tokens.doc: Width of the edge of a fresh pennant (ink on the day ground, light on the night ground)

tokens.name: flag.edgeHollow
tokens.doc: Width of the side-coloured edge of a carried-forward pennant

tokens.name: detail.corpsNameZoom
tokens.doc: From this zoom a corps (and a crowd of one) says its name

tokens.name: detail.divisionNameZoom
tokens.doc: From this zoom a division (and a crowd of one) says its name

tokens.name: detail.brigadeNameZoom
tokens.doc: From this zoom a brigade says its name

tokens.name: detail.codeZoom
tokens.doc: From this zoom a unit pip carries its short code (below it a pip is bare: pointing says which unit it is).  The site opens at 13.5, where the formations and crowds are named and the regiments are bare pips: half the lettering of round 1, one rank of bold

tokens.name: detail.crowdNameZoom
tokens.doc: From this zoom a crowd pennant says what its units share (a formation, a corps, both armies): a number alone never stands for hidden units

tokens.name: detail.selectGrowZoom
tokens.doc: From this zoom a selected mark grows its name and the layout makes room for it; below it the selection is a ring (the crowd pennant that stands for a hidden unit gets the ring) and nothing moves, so selecting never re-flows a crowded overview

tokens.name: detail.selectNameMinViewport
tokens.doc: A selected mark grows its full name only when the window is at least this wide (px); on a phone the sheet carries the name and the mark stays small

tokens.name: detail.unitNameZoom
tokens.doc: From this zoom a unit says its full name: the same mark grows, there is no second box

tokens.name: detail.hullZoom
tokens.doc: From this zoom a crowd shows the true positions of the units it stands for

tokens.name: carried.hollow
tokens.doc: How far a carried-forward pip or pennant hollows: 0 = no change, 1 = fully hollow with a thick side-coloured ring

tokens.name: carried.glass
tokens.doc: Opacity of the glass inside a hollow mark

tokens.name: carried.tint
tokens.doc: How much of the side colour tints that glass (the hue stays, so a carried-forward mark is never grey)

tokens.name: hull.dot
tokens.doc: Radius of the dot on the true position of one unit a crowd stands for (shown while the crowd is pointed at or selected)

tokens.name: hull.leader
tokens.doc: Opacity of the hairlines from a crowd to its units while it is pointed at or selected

tokens.name: pin.r
tokens.doc: Radius of the true-position ring

tokens.name: leader.width
tokens.doc: Width of the hairline from the true position to its mark

tokens.name: leader.alpha
tokens.doc: Opacity of that hairline

tokens.name: sel.gap
tokens.doc: Space between the pip and the selection ring

tokens.name: sel.width
tokens.doc: Width of the selection ring, in the mark’s own side colour under a paper hairline

tokens.name: hover.width
tokens.doc: Width of the fainter hover ring

tokens.name: motion.selectMs
tokens.doc: Ease of the selection ring (critically damped)

tokens.name: motion.hoverMs
tokens.doc: Ease of the hover state

interface.note: src/ui/quiet.css, section 0. Dark is the chrome of the night ground, light of the day ground; the day theme overrides only the listed names.
